::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/conflicts"}
#docs
Records changed both here and in HubSpot since the last sync while the conflict rule is `flag`. Neither direction syncs a record while its conflict is open.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of conflicts to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | A conflict id (`hscf_…`) from the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The conflicts. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The conflict's id (hscf_…). |
| `data.status` | `string` | The conflict's status. One of `open`, `resolved`. |
| `data.local_type` | `string` | The type of our record: `customer` or `subscription`. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `data.local_id` | `string` | Our record's public id. |
| `data.remote_type` | `string` | The type of the HubSpot record. One of `contact`, `company`, `deal`. |
| `data.remote_id` | `string` | The id of the HubSpot record. |
| `data.fields` | `array of object` | The fields. |
| `data.remote_updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the HubSpot record was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.detected_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the conflict was found (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.resolution` | `string` | Which value was kept: `ours` or `theirs`. Null while unresolved. One of `ours`, `theirs`. |
| `data.resolved_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the conflict was resolved (ISO-8601 UTC), or null. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more conflicts exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of open conflicts |
